items.docs: A derivative is a file that is based on another source, for example, a low-resolution representation of a print-quality photo. During the upload process, Bynder can automatically create pre-defined image derivatives with different dimensions, quality, and format. Bynder can either maintain the original aspect ratio of an image, or crop or pad an image to fit the specified dimensions.
